description: SMS AB Pass is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Trucking and Motorcoaches", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation. SMS Interstate Passenger Carriers only - This data file contains the FMCSA summary results of SMS for all active interstate and intrastate hazmat passenger (aka bus) motor carriers only. Also includes percentile and alert status not found in other downloads. File is comma delimited. One carrier per row. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Trucking and Motorcoaches". It has 36 columns, among them DRIV_FIT_MEASURE, VEH_MAINT_PCT, CONTR_SUBST_MEASURE, HOS_DRIV_INSP_W_VIOL, UNSAFE_DRIV_PCT, VEHICLE_OOS_INSP_TOTAL. The portal shows 2026-09-13 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
